cards.headline: TRUMP PUTS IRAN WAR DECISION OFF TO 2027
cards.detail: Asked about action against Iran, Trump says he will see what happens after Jan. 1.

cards.headline: WORLD COURT FINDS MYANMAR COMMITTED GENOCIDE
cards.detail: In The Gambia case over Rohingya, the ICJ rules 9–6 on the 2016–17 crackdown.

cards.headline: ANTHROPIC CLOSES FIRST DAY UP 17%
cards.detail: The AI company’s record $81.3bn IPO values it at about $1.76tn at close.

cards.headline: RUSSIAN STRIKES HIT KYIV; EMBASSIES DAMAGED
cards.detail: Overnight attacks damage Dutch and Austrian embassy buildings; a residential strike kills one.

cards.headline: ADNOC VESSEL ATTACKED IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ
cards.detail: One crew member is missing after an attack; separate reports describe a tanker fire.

cards.headline: HERZOG TAPS EISENKOT TO FORM ISRAELI GOVERNMENT
cards.detail: The president tasks Netanyahu challenger Gadi Eisenkot with trying to build a coalition.

cards.headline: CYCLONE AKVAN APPROACHES INDIA’S ODISHA COAST
cards.detail: More than 80,000 people are evacuated ahead of expected landfall.

cards.headline: TAIWAN TIGHTENS RULES AS STOCKS SLIDE
cards.detail: Regulators announce stabilising steps and short-sale curbs after a steep three-day fall.

cards.headline: DRONE SCARE HALTS FLIGHTS AT GENOA AIRPORT
cards.detail: Unidentified drones prompt an overnight suspension of airport operations.

cards.headline: UKRAINE’S EUROPEAN ALLIES OPEN TO RUSSIA TALKS
cards.detail: Leaders in Berlin say Europe has a united negotiating position and is ready for talks.

cards.headline: FOUR COUNTRIES URGE AID ACCESS TO FLOODED GAZA
cards.detail: Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK call for immediate, unrestricted humanitarian access.

cards.headline: GIANT STAR SEEN SWALLOWING ITS COMPANION
cards.detail: Astronomers report a seven-year observation of a star engulfing another in Andromeda.

briefs.text: Houthis claim strikes on four Saudi targets; Riyadh reports damage to a landmark building.
Israeli airstrike hits a Hezbollah missile facility in eastern Lebanon.
Israeli military completes a ground operation in Gaza beyond the Yellow Line.
France braces for a fourth weekend of cost-of-living protests.
One dead and 15 injured after fire in an 18-storey French apartment block.
South Korea’s annual exports pass $1 trillion for the first time.
California opens a probe into Nvidia AI-chip sales to China.
Cyber incidents at JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard expose customer data.
Trump posthumously pardons baseball star Pete Rose.
Trump backs firing of US cyber chief Sean Cairncross amid tech outages.
State Department details $12bn in Venezuelan oil and mineral revenue.
India–Japan talks: Japanese forces to train on Indian firing ranges from 2027.
Japan’s Takaichi says Tokyo’s Taiwan stance is unchanged.
COP31 AI pledge draws no major US technology companies.
BBC reports families trapped as Houthis hold Yemen’s besieged Taiz.
India’s Justice Varma tells parliament resignation is not an admission of guilt.
India bowl New Zealand out for 368 on day two of Wellington Test.
South Africa captain Bavuma ruled out of Bangladesh series decider.
Wet first practice curtails running at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Fiona the hippo dies at Cincinnati Zoo after swallowing a hat.
Oil prices flat as Hormuz disruption offsets oversupply concerns.
Trump warns APEC nations strict AI rules could stifle development.
Trump returns from China and holds a White House press conference.
Indian public-sector banks post record half-year profit of about ₹1.10 lakh crore.
Israel says it completes withdrawal preparations under Gaza plan.
Genoa drone scare marks another European airport disruption this month.

date_check: LEFT OUT: Trump–Xi–Putin trilateral summit and peace declaration in Shenzhen (19 Nov) · GTA VI launch and reviews (19 Nov) · Nvidia’s $115.8bn quarter (17 Nov) · US strike on Qeshm Island (18 Nov) · Alaska Senate result giving Democrats a majority (18 Nov).
